evidence.says: LC heading is Díaz del Castillo, Bernal, 1496–1584. Its source notes identify the author of The true history of the conquest of Mexico (1938), and list alternative headings with 1492, circa 1492 and 1495. LC links Q315795, VIAF 59081563 and GND 118671804.

Native name and default label are Bernal Díaz del Castillo. Occupations include chronicler and historian; notable work is Historia verdadera de la conquista de la Nueva España. P244 is n50002086; VIAF 59081563 and GND 118671804 match LC. Birth statements include preferred circa 1492 and an alternative 1496.

The entry’s Open Library author is Bernal Díaz del Castillo, dated 1496–1584, associated with Historia verdadera de la conquista de la Nueva España. Its identifiers explicitly include LC n50002086, Wikidata Q315795 and VIAF 59081563.

BnF identifies the chronicler of the conquest of New Spain, with heading 1492?–1581? and Historia verdadera among its sources. Its source notes also report a study dating birth between October 1495 and March 1496, and cite LC’s 1496–1584 heading.
The National Library of Chile uses the author heading Díaz del Castillo, Bernal, 1492–ca. 1581 and lists Historia verdadera de la conquista de la Nueva España (1632).
The literary encyclopedia gives birth year 1492, identifies Historia verdadera de la conquista de la Nueva España, and links LC n50002086 and VIAF 59081563.

notes: Same person and correct LC assignment to the graph key. The birth mismatch reflects conflicting dates for this author, not two identities. Birth year left null: 1492 has substantial support, but BnF qualifies it and records competing 1495–1496 evidence; LC retains 1496. Wikidata’s English label “Bernal Díaz del Brawl” is anomalous; its other names, work and identifiers establish the match. LC was read through its linked-data representation because the HTML page was unavailable.
